_comment: The product catalogue. Written down once here so the brand site, each product subdomain and the account backend all agree on what exists, and mirrored into catalog.products_mw by migration so the database can hold foreign keys against it. Adding a product is a commit to this file plus a migration that re-runs the seed. isPaid says whether the product ever charges, not whether a given user is paying - registration and entitlement are separate questions and live in separate columns on catalog.user_products_mw.
